svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":8,"chapter":"Ch.8 · Buy the Field","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"In the besieged city Jeremiah buys a field at Anathoth and seals the deed, for the Lord promises houses and fields will again be bought. Stage: a walled city under siege at dusk, a deed being sealed and buried in an earthen jar, a field beyond the walls; a candle in a siege lamp.","materials":["assets/materials/wall_brick-herringbone.svg","assets/materials/stone-flagstone.svg","assets/materials/water_still-eddies.svg"],"seed":1}
